title: Grinding Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Grinding Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Project Information

JSA ID: GRIND-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

GRINDER TYPE: ☐ Bench ☐ Pedestal ☐ Hand-held ☐ Surface WHEEL TYPE: ______________

LOCATION: ______________ OPERATOR: ______________ SUPERVISOR: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Inspection & Setup-Cracked wheel
-Wrong wheel
-Damaged guards
-Missing tool rest		-Wheel explosion
-Eye injury
-Laceration		25 (VERY HIGH)-Ring test all wheels
-Check RPM rating matches grinder
-Verify guard in place & secure
-Adjust tool rest (1/8" gap)
-Ensure tongue guard adjusted
2. Startup & Warm-up-Wheel imbalance
-Vibration
-Loose parts		-Wheel disintegration
-Struck by debris		16 (HIGH)-Stand aside during startup
-Run at operating speed for 1 minute
-Listen for unusual sounds
-Check for smooth operation
3. Grinding Operation-Flying sparks
-Hot metal
-Dust/fumes
-Kickback (hand-held)		-Eye injury
-Burns
-Respiratory illness
-Hand injury		20 (VERY HIGH)-Position work to direct sparks away
-Use proper lighting
-Maintain proper angle
-Let wheel do the work
-Use light pressure
4. Workpiece Handling-Heat buildup
-Sharp burrs
-Heavy parts		-Burns
-Cuts
-Strain		8 (MEDIUM)-Use gloves when handling
-Deburr edges
-Let parts cool
-Use proper lifting technique
5. Shutdown & Cleanup-Coasting wheel
-Hot surfaces
-Dust accumulation		-Contact injury
-Burns
-Fire hazard		6 (MEDIUM)-Allow wheel to stop completely
-Clean around grinder
-Remove combustibles near sparks
-Empty dust collection
-Check for wheel damage

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Face Shield ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ Apron ☐ Respiratory Protection (if needed)
